requirements.required: Real standalone text and image tiles, TXT-to-text import, ordered images document with current page; trusted admission -> bounded preparation -> final resource durability -> transactional references/version -> coherent native Scene -> visible/hidden result; clear/undo/page/replace/restart included. A node enum, image header validator, static sample canvas or downloadable original alone does not complete this chain.

Current COURSE selects exact class/subject/actualTeacher after timetable/calendar/override resolution. Whole profile/content/resources/layout/clip/hits publish in one generation. Missing/disabled/invalid scope uses explicit neutral fallback without borrowing same-subject other-teacher or stale previous profile. Break uses public visuals and only independently authorized prior Materials directory, not prior subject text/images; next course and override/rebind/revoke invalidate old prepared media.

Persistent replacement-intent acceptedSequence and expectedRevision plus commandId/fingerprint. A slow then B fast: A superseded; B accepted then fails: retain last committed, never resurrect A. Local/Web permitted commands share the relevant authority/serialization. Clear and targetRevision undo create new bounded commands/revisions; undo cannot overwrite another owner/newer update. Ordered page navigation correlates current content and generation.

ACCEPTED/PREPARING/COMMITTED distinct from visible/hidden/renderfailed/replaced/inactive. PPT hide does not roll back commit or falsely show visible. Old committed command remains committed with REPLACED display state after later publication. Unknown postCOMMIT is query-original-only, not cleanup/delete/retry with new ID.

facts: Latest module07/17 restricts all layout/component/profile appearance writing and management reads to fresh exact LOCAL global-admin lease; teacher/user/Web cannot save profile or shared protection layout.

Teacher Web currently has exactly homework, own classroom materials, school shared today-reminder, and authorized voice modules. Current12/13/15 explicit commands replace old generic API sketch; legacy broad text/image publish cannot be revived as an unbounded Web write route.

Teacher role can write only own valid assigned homework/material content; USER has current published read/local-open access, no write merely from stale teaching assignments. Shared reminder stays Web-only even for global admin.

All sensitive reads, preview/history/resource reads, admission, final commit and actual display/effect recheck latest authority/HealthGate; requested IDs or remembered profile identity are not capability.
authorityBoundary.recommendedConcreteScope: Implement standalone content management locally under existing global-admin management lease for public fallback outlet or exact subject profile; protected public widgets remain protected. This is authorized by global manage-all/profile rules. Do not infer a new teacher Web text/image/profile capability from historical F04 local/Web wording.
authorityBoundary.needsExplicitContractIfExpanded: If teacher may publish independent media through existing My Materials, freeze a separate narrow capability/target/owner/content command within that business module first; do not expose a generic endpoint or merge visual-layout writes into upload. Current four-module contract does not itself specify such standalone writes.
authorityBoundary.localReadonlyNavigation: Page/view action can remain available for currently displayed published content under a narrow same-generation display capability, not an admin layout/publish capability. Editing content/layout remains privileged.

budgetsToRetain.textCountDecision: Define scalar/grapheme/UTF16 counting once; existing default says10000characters. Do not silently substitute homework16384UTF8bytes or rendering262144UTF16units. Recommended Unicode scalar count with strict decoded-byte/serialized-document caps, no silent truncation.

image.pageManifest: Explicit ordered resource/version references and bounded current page; each page uses image limits. No all50decoded buffers or automatic slideshow.
image.note: 200MiB is rebuildable cache, not originals. Do not promise50x10MiB collections always fit: total active/history/staged/orphan reservations need an explicit aggregate disk policy. No whole-document heap allocation follows from per-page limits.

workers.constraint: Reuse total existing worker/resource reservations; no new static media2 lane on top of material/voice/KDF2. Physical permit remains held until actual file/decoder worker returns, even after logical cancellation or old App Drop.

graphics.previewMax: 960x540/2MiB with classroom surfaces released before separate preview; each actual image/DIB/CPU scratch/display cache target charged once at real simultaneous capacity

budgetsToRetain.nativeMeasurement: Aspect-preserving display at assigned final width/DPI; no unbounded font shrinking, full original pixel caches, per-page HWND/thread or1Hz image/tree redecode. Image cache + WIC provider/native peak + renderer buffers all contribute to process total.
budgetsToRetain.textVersusImagePageLimit: 50page limit applies paginated image document; existing long text pagination16384 remains a distinct rendering cap.
budgetsToRetain.storageAndProtocol: Each bounded persisted document/index block <=64KiB; do not stuff4096profiles,10kUnicode body+full tree or50pixel payloads in one unbounded document/DTO. File/pixel bytes stay outside domain/protocol and command queue.
budgetsToRetain.preparationTiming: Existing chunk copy/validation32KiB, validation CPU10s/wall30s and cancellation checks retain finite quotas. Checks between synchronous Read/CopyPixels do not prove physical cancellation of an executing native call; keep its owner/permit charged.

currentGaps.fact: ContentKey only Homework and SharedReminder, text-only ContentCommand, max16KiB; no independent typed slot/resource-pages/history/prepare lifecycle. Cannot repurpose reminders to bypass local-only standalone requirements or lose date/origin rules.

Profile currently holds tree/folder/materials settings only. SubjectText/SubjectImage explicitly UnsupportedWidget and component_kindNone. New node-specific text/media identity/settings/resource refs must be real, independently scoped, bounded and persisted. Removing Unsupported alone is not implementation.

TXT validates UTF8 (optional BOM) and BOM UTF16LE/BE incrementally plus control/surrogate validity; returns character count/metadata, not prepared bounded display text. Longer original TXT files are permitted. Need decoded-text importer with explicit encoding/count/errors, not read_to_end/lossy conversion or claim validator success is displayed content.

Existing full WIC validation serializes decoder and returns dimensions/decoded byte count, scans bounded tiles and discards pixels. There is no standalone display-size image producer/cache/Scene image handoff here. Explicit64KiB scan buffer does not bound WIC internal codec peak.

Current CardContent contains clock/text/course/homework/recess/materials/control, no independent image/page image descriptor and actual image drawing/action path. Text body machinery is reusable for measured native text, not independent content authority/persistence.

Need content editor/import picker/review/cancel/CAS/results; trusted prepared ownership and resource store; single-writer admission/commands/history/ref transactions; coherent exact-profile Facts; real native text+image/page rendering/hits; crash recovery/GC and tests. Existing My Materials append semantics must stay independent of replacement-slot sequence.

proposedAcceptanceMatrix.pass: Fresh local global admin creates standalone text, imports legal TXT, selects image, builds ordered2/50page images in existing public outlet/exact profile editor; review/cancel/save work. Actual real DirectWrite/WIC/native pixels and visible-page actions correspond to committed same-generation resource/version; restart recovers saved content/page policy. No schema/sample-only success.

Teacher/user/Web/stale/revoked lease cannot change profile/layout/media attachment; old generic text/image HTTP paths remain rejected. Same-subject other teacher/class and raw path/URL/UNC rejected. Allowed preview/read/history uses fresh exact scope. Narrow current-page view action grants no publish capability.

Deterministic A slow/B fast and B failed/A late preserve correct last committed version and terminal SUPERSEDED. Target/teacher/revision changes mid-copy/decode or owner lock/revoke/scene switch prevent final attach/display; late output only cleans its own unpublished data.

Real full PNG/JPEG/BMP decode, file type mismatch, truncated image,10MiB/8MP exact and1over; strict UTF8/UTF16 BOM/surrogate/control/multi-block and10000-character boundaries; illegal/oversized input rejects without changing old committed content. Defined image scaling/alpha/aspect/DPI and measured/cached bytes verified.

0/1/50/51pages, chosen order and explicit reorder before review, current-page bounds, first/last wrap policy, replacement while page event queued, repeated identical bytes without changing authored order, fixed resource versions and scoped nodeID action routing. No implicit filename sorting or timer/animation loop.

Clear/undo/replace are explicit idempotent commands and revisionchecked. Undo targets current revision and a retained accessible predecessor; conflicts preserve current. Retained history/resources are bounded, unavailable history returns explicit cannotundo. Live old snapshot/decode/proof/history refs survive GC; new final files synced before SQL refs; uncertain committed files never removed by unattempted cleanup.

Inject crash at copy/validate/final-file/SQL/COMMIT/publication/query and retry originalID; only own orphan after grace/reference checks cleaned. Missing/corrupt referenced files fail closed or explicitly neutral not silently another image. Disk full/cache full/stalled decode retain previous content and physical accounting. Backup restores consistent media refs without resurrecting auth, ended lesson profile or expired reminder.

Same subject two teachers, actual overrides/restores, exact profile missing/disabled, class switch, lesson end/BREAK/nextCOURSE, calendar revision and wake all produce coherent content/tree/clip/hits. BREAK shows public visual with last valid Materials directory only; no old subject image/text leak or future teacher prefetch.

Two prepare/one decode physically enforced across app replacement/cancel, current+bounded prefetch32MiBcache, original/staged/history/orphan200MiBcache/2GiBoriginals ledgers distinct, compositor16MiB allsimultaneous buffers, worker queue8/4MiB and process64/96/160MiB measured. UI/Writer never do fullcopy/decode/join; provider calls can delay logical timeout but no owner/free/replacement fiction.

Host rules + real SQLite + actual Win11 native synthetic endtoend and visible user QA are separate. Win7 SP1x86/Win10 actual devices/formalMSVC, PPT/foreground/click-through, touch/DPI,72h and total memory remain individual gates. Local full chain can advance without pretending unresolved productionTLS/P0 is solved.

decisionsToFreezeBeforeImplementation: Exact independent slot key: public fallback or SubjectProfileKey+stableNodeId/contentId. Content and visual revisions separate; moving/hiding a node must not silently delete content/resources.
Text10000 character/count/encoding/control/whitespace/empty semantics and serialized64KiB cap; TXT import is a copied immutable snapshot versus live external file (recommended snapshot).

Page as bounded command carrying contentRevision+SceneGeneration; whether page state persists and independent viewRevision. It must not use admin layout capability or supersede replacement intent merely to navigate.
Ordered import/reorder and repeated-resource policy; default manual static navigation, no timer. Define1page as image versus document with1page and contain/crop rule rather than accidental clipping.

Bounded history count/bytes/retention, command-result query/retry window and resource orphan grace. D11 requires finite values but does not provide standalone-content numeric defaults, so document actual chosen caps rather than invent them as prior requirements.
Aggregate disk reservations for multi-page preparation and resource dedup/ref ownership; image display cache admission/preload count (current + at most a small explicitly budgeted neighbor).

Whether teachers may ever update independent body in current My Materials module: not inferred from historical generic Web draft, and must not add visual/profile write authority. Localglobal complete chain is directly consistent with current permissions.
limits: This is document/code reading and implementation-contract advice, not implementation or runtime evidence. No official API or P0 research undertaken.
Some broad F04 local/Web language predates four-module whitelist; latest explicit role/channel capability wins. Recommendations are labeled and must not be described as already implemented.
Standalone content does not justify newcrate/dependency direction, browser runtime, thumbnail generation of all Materials or loss of existing budgets.
